item.title: Beatbox Video About Having 'Hella Money' Goes Viral, inspiring Thousands Of Videos On Reels, TikTok
item.description: I Got Like Hella Money is a viral video and song by Kell Martin in which he sings and beatboxes in his car, "I got like hella money," and shows off that he has five dollars. Martin posted the video to his TikTok account @shutthekellup in early January 2026.
